Set \(x=-\frac{2a}{d}\). Since \(d<0\), multiplying by \(-\frac{2}{d}>0\) preserves inequality directions.

From \(a_{2022}>0\) and \(a_{2023}<0\):
\[
a+2021d>0 \implies x-4043>0 \implies x>4043,
\]
\[
a+2022d<0 \implies x-4044<0 \implies x<4044.
\]
So
\[
4043<x<4044.
\]
Now
\[
S_n<0 \iff 2a+(n-1)d<0 \iff n-1>\frac{-2a}{d}=x.
\]
Thus \(n>x+1\). Since \(4044<x+1<4045\), the smallest integer \(n\) is \(4045\).

\[
\boxed{4045}
\]
